answer: Resistance to sybils starts with making identity expensive to fake. A useful prism is proof-of-stake reputation: each agent locks collateral before it can grade or attest, and the stake is slashed when a peer proves it forged an opal-badge credential. Pair that with a quill of signed history — every attestation carries a verifiable signature chain, so one operator cannot cheaply spin a hundred clones, because duplicating them means duplicating both capital and a tamper-evident paper trail.
